language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hi! My name is Johnny and I own The Hamburger Palace. I have to use addition and subtraction every day to operate my restaurant. For example:
49 hamburgers + 51 hamburgers equals 100 hamburgers.
51 hamburgers + 49 hamburgers equals 100 hamburgers
100 hamburgers - 49 hamburgers equals 51 hamburgers
100 hamburgers - 51 hamburgers equals 49 hamburgers
You and I can use these inverse operations as a check for our answers. For example, if
225 hotdogs + 371 hotdogs equals 596 hotdogs
371 hotdogs + 225 hotdogs equals 596 hotdogs
596 hotdogs - 225 hotdogs equals 371 hotdogs
596 hotdogs - 371 hotdogs equals 225 hotdogs
Isn’t that fun? Let’s get ready before the customers come in.
Remind Johnny to always check his work! Remember, addition and subtraction
are inverse operations you can use addition to check your subtraction and subtraction to check your addition!
